title: Project-pinned runtime
situation: A project may depend on its own version of cratylus while the host has another installed globally; inside cratylus's own workspace the operator reaches the workspace build as pnpm cratylus while the tool calls the global command. Raised by cut 6's judgment (M2).
decision: Settle whether a project's own pinned cratylus wins over the global one, for the tool and the command alike, so capability port's 'both always reach the same version' holds inside such projects; pnpm 12's globalShims, which dispatches a global bin to a project's own node_modules/.bin, is a candidate.
